messages:
Aisha: Quick Q from new hire week: where's the canonical place to keep ramp notes in Notion? Also I keep hitting a 'can't invite group' error when trying to get edit on templates. Any steps?
Ken: Welcome! Canonical personal spot: Workspace > Private > Onboarding > Ramp Notes. For shared templates it's Docs Home > Team Spaces > Devex > Onboarding Templates.
Zoe: If you're collating examples for teammates, create a public summary page (title: "Aisha - Ramp summary") and link your private notes. Keeps raw notes private but allows feedback.
devex-bot: How-to: Request editor via `/doc-access request <page-link>` or open the page -> Share -> Request edit -> send to docs-admin@redwood.com. SLA: 24 business hours for normal requests.
Aisha: The share flow errors when I try to add the group doc-editors@redwood.com (403). Is there an SSO/group provisioning step?
Ken: Yeah if your SSO group wasn't provisioned you get that. Easiest fix: ping people-ops in this thread or email people-ops@redwood.com and ask for `docs-editors` group membership. They can also add you manually to the page.
people-ops: Confirmed: we occasionally need to reprovision vendor/contractor accounts. If you're a contractor, we need completed vendor onboarding + DPA before granting access to restricted team spaces. Send org:team and reason.
Zoe: Another option: duplicate the template into Private, make your edits, then create a Template Update request: Docs Home > Governance > Template updates -> New Request. Attach link and one-line rationale.
Aisha: I did duplicate but want to push small fixes upstream. Does the docs team want a changelog format?
Ken: Yes — add a short changelog block at the top: `Summary: ...` `Why: ...` `Impact: ...` and add tag `#template-change`. Docs team reviews and merges.
Aisha: Helpful. Also, where do we put page Owner metadata? I don't see that field on older templates.
Zoe: Add a small properties block at top: `Owner: <handle>` `Team: devex` `Tags: #onboarding #ramp`. If Owner missing, ping #devex-docs for assignment.
devex-bot: If manual add needed, docs-admin will follow up. Run `/doc-help` if no action in 48h.
Aisha: Thanks all — emailed people-ops and left a Template Update request. Will post back when resolved :smile:
